payload.title: Creating Murmuration Plots for Interglacial Data
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate correlations between speleothem oxygen isotope data and insolation at various latitudes, focusing on interglacial periods. It includes defining a function for handling correlations in datasets with large hiatuses, constructing insolation curves using the Climlab library, processing data to isolate interglacial records, calculating correlations, and visualizing the results using murmuration plots.
